title: Offer native plain prepared-publication overlap as opt-in
question: Can independent prepared files publish concurrently within existing resource contracts?
summary: Ship experimental-plain-publication for native builds while keeping serial defaults and existing Run eligibility.

workloads: Prepared plain files; fixed 200k-row allocation/shuffle probe with small caps and a separate 10-MB-cap comparison.

validation.summary: Fresh Linux default/all-feature checks and native Windows release contracts/CLI smoke cover parity, caps, partial batch capacity, cancellation and typed-denial cleanup.

limitations: Small development cells and uncontrolled cache/background state do not establish general device, shape or tail performance.
Historical percentage gains are not additive; every comparison uses its own pinned baseline.
Concurrent owners may deny later work; no retry or admission-parity guarantee.
Direct limits-only Run and WASI keep their existing paths; no Auto threshold or browser speed claim.
exclusions: Feature delivery tests add no timed jobs.
Initial Windows artifact-glob failure stays incomplete; the corrected fresh batch is separate.
